advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
advancements.doctor_m.obtain_time_key.de: We have the power to do whatever we want. Absolute control over every particle in the universe. Absolute control over everything that ever existed and everything that ever will. From now on, are you listening to me, Romana? Because if you aren't, I can make you listen, for I can do anything. From this moment on, there is no free will in the entire universe. Only my will, for I possess the Key of Time!
message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: No Time Lord president has ever obtained the Key of Rassilon except Rassilon himself...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bOwner of the Time Key, your authority does not end here. You will not be troubled by something as trivial as death. The Hexad God is still watching over you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: §7A crystal that may have countless origins*Rassilon once possessed it, or perhaps its creator*Now, you have obtained it, and the universe shall bow to you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.detail: §dWith it, the power under grace will elevate you above the Guardians of Time*When you 'die', you will be revived and instantly kill all enemies within 35 blocks, cooldown 10 seconds. Attacks will deal bonus percentage damage based on your attack damage, cooldown 1 second*Any damage that can affect you is capped at 15% of your max health, and arrows will be erased by your power*Every second you will heal for 10% of your max health and extinguish any fire on you*You gain the ability to fly, and become immune to fire, suffocation, potion effects, and echo shockwave damage.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: §7A pocket watch... It looks ordinary. Maybe.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.detail: §7When the player takes fatal damage, force revive the player and deal 25 damage to all mobs within 10 blocks.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dYour journey is not yet over. The Hexad God watches you, awaiting where your path will finally lead...
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.cooldown: §cThe pocket watch cannot protect you forever. You must wait for it to recover. Time remaining: %s
message.doctor_m.mystery_gem: §7As time passes, her power is no longer what it once was, but may she still bless you...
message.doctor_m.mystery_gem.detail: §7While equipped, you gain permanent Resistance II, which reduces damage taken by 40%.
message.doctor_m.eternal_crystal.desc: §7Once blessed by Him, the divine power has waned over time, but what remains is still enough to make all life tremble in fear.
message.doctor_m.eternal_crystal.detail: §7While equipped, each of your attacks will deal an additional forced 50% damage based on your attack damage. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
